title: Buying Your First Soccer Ball
description: A new player visits a sports shop to choose a soccer ball and asks the clerk about size and price.
transcript: Hi there, welcome to our shop. Can I help you today? Yes, I want a soccer ball. Great. We have many balls here. This ball is size five. It is the most common size for adults. This ball is size four. It is good for kids. The big one is size five. It costs twenty dollars. The small one costs fifteen dollars. Which one do you like? I like the size five. Good choice. Do you want to take it now? Yes, I will take it. Thank you for visiting our shop. Have a great day and enjoy your new ball!

title: Learning the Offside Rule
description: A coach explains to a new player why a teammate was called offside during practice.
transcript: Hey, come over here for a minute. Do you see that player near the goal? That is Marco. He is standing very far forward. Look at the defenders. They are standing behind him. Now watch the ball. Our passer kicks it forward. Marco runs to the ball. But the referee raises the flag. Marco is offside. Why? Because he was ahead of the last defender when the ball was passed. Remember this rule. It is simple. Stay level with or behind the second-last defender when your teammate passes the ball. Then you are onside.

title: Shoes for the Court
description: A teenager asks a store employee which basketball shoes are good for playing on hard outdoor courts.
transcript: Hi there! Can I help you find something today? Basketball shoes, right? We have a lot of good ones. For hard outdoor courts, you need shoes with strong grip. Outdoor courts are rough, so the sole matters a lot. Look for a thick rubber bottom with deep lines. These shoes give you good traction. They also protect your feet. Try this pair. It has good ankle support and it is not too heavy. Would you like to try them on? Take your time. Walk around a little and see how they feel.

title: Choosing a Tennis Racket
description: A beginner asks a shop worker how to pick a lightweight racket that is right for her size.
transcript: Hi there! Can I help you find something today? Great. Are you looking for a tennis racket? Good choice. Do you play a lot? That's nice. title: Keeping Score in Tennis
description: Two players explain to a new spectator how points, games and sets work during a match.
transcript: Hi, welcome to tennis! Let me show you how the score works. First, a match has sets. Each set has games. Each game has points. The points go zero, fifteen, thirty, forty. You win a game when you get four points and you lead by two. Next, six games win a set. Then, two sets win the match. So, watch the points, count the games, and then count the sets. Easy, right?

title: Weekend Lesson at the Club
description: A student tells a friend about her first tennis lesson at the local club and what the coach taught her.
transcript: Hi, I want to tell you about my weekend. On Saturday, I went to the local club for my first tennis lesson. I was a little nervous. The coach was very friendly. Her name is Maria. First, she showed me how to hold the racket. Then she taught me the forehand. I hit the ball many times. Some balls went over the fence. But Maria said, good, keep going. At the end, I felt happy and tired. I want to go again next weekend.
